title: Volume slider ignores keys after mouse focus
steps: Sound & screen → click volume around 71% → press End, then repeat with Right.
actual: The value and PipeWire level stayed at 71%. Mouse movement restored it to 100%.
expected: Keyboard adjustment should work after the intended slider is focused. Tab-focused behavior needs a separate test.

title: Files fields have inconsistent, undersized geometry
steps: Open Files; compare path/search fields and New folder/Rename name fields with nearby buttons.
actual: Fields are visibly about 18–22px tall while buttons are about 30px.
expected: Use comfortable shared control geometry; text-area exceptions should be intentional.

title: Files Ctrl+V fails while Paste button succeeds
steps: Select disposable alpha.txt → Ctrl+C → navigate to another disposable directory → Ctrl+V. Retry Ctrl+V, then click Paste.
actual: Internal clipboard status and Paste button become available; Ctrl+V leaves destination empty. Paste button creates an exact byte-for-byte copy.
expected: Keyboard Paste should invoke the same operation as the button.

title: Keyboard-owner status is misleading
steps: Leave Files open, click Apps search, type brave.
actual: App list filters and the Files surface dims, but footer still says FILES HAS THE KEYBOARD.
expected: Footer should identify the actual input owner or omit a misleading claim.

title: Installed Music volume popup spills below workspace
steps: Open Music → More → click the volume slider near the bottom edge.
actual: Slider appears below the main rounded workspace and clicking it did not change the service volume (100%).
expected: Keep popup controls inside an interactive area. The new visible volume component exists in source but is not installed: retest after activation before another fix.

title: Escape closes Music instead of only its popup
steps: Open Music → More → press Escape once.
actual: Entire player closes and the terminal is revealed. No subsequent keys were sent to that terminal.
expected: Dismiss the active popup first; another Escape may close the player.

title: Music Clear button wraps its label
steps: Type a non-empty search in the Music rail.
actual: Clear displays as Cle / ar on two lines and increases the search row height.
expected: Provide a usable consistent clear target without label wrapping.

title: Health logs expose raw ANSI formatting
actual: ANSI escape fragments appear as visible text in log lines.
expected: Strip or render terminal formatting in the diagnostic display.

title: Quick Settings is obscured by native windows
steps: Open Quick Settings while a native window occupies the workspace.
actual: Native client covers part of popup. User confirmed: Partly hidden behind the window.
expected: Quick Settings should appear above native windows and remain usable.
